name: Tenor
long_description: Your AI spend becomes accountable labor: every AI worker gets a job, persistent context, a budget, guardrails, and outcomes you can measure. Tenor deploys AI inside businesses to run entire jobs across their existing tools, not isolated tasks. Companies define the outcomes and KPIs; every result improves how the worker makes decisions over time.
one_liner: AI that own jobs end-to-end and learn from every outcome
